title: Describe collaboration
text: How do you handle disagreement in a team?

options.text: I avoid all discussion and continue alone.
options.response: 这一说法忽略了关键条件，需要重新分析。

options.text: I ask the leader to choose without checking the proposals.
options.response: 提到了部分处理方式，但解释还不完整。

options.text: I clarify the assumptions, compare the proposals and agree on a specific test.
options.response: 回答说明了关键条件和处理方法。
